summary: Verified fix for staff portal doctor-leave slot blocking. Wrote pytest test_staff_slots_leave_block.py covering: (a) full-day block via POST /api/doctor-schedule/block-date -> GET /api/diagyn-staff/slots/available returns empty morning/evening/available slots + leave message, (b) evening session block 18:00-22:00 -> only evening slots emptied while morning remains, (c) walk-in mode (mode=walkin) on a fully-blocked today returns empty, (d) open-day regression returns normal slot buckets, (e) patient-facing /api/appointments/booked-slots regression continues to return date_blocked:true for a blocked date. All 7 tests pass against live preview backend. Clinic name must be 'Pushpa Clinic' (not 'Pushpa'), doctor name must be 'Dr. Vikas Jha' — matches DiaGynStaffPortal.js and DOCTOR_SCHEDULE in diagyn_staff/shared.py.
critical_code_review_comments: slots.py: reserved_slots {'11:00','11:15'} are hard-coded in two places (patient booked-slots endpoint and staff slots.py). Consider centralizing.

get_doctor_schedule_by_name looks up by db.staff.name/doctor_name — case-sensitive. Fine currently but fragile if a name variant is introduced (e.g. 'Vikas Jha' vs 'Dr. Vikas Jha'). The staff portal frontend always sends 'Dr. Vikas Jha', so OK.

The teleconsultation.py defensive fix is safe but as flagged, TeleconsultPage.jsx is fully mocked and NextAvailableButton.jsx / Teleconsultation.js appear orphaned. Grep confirms /api/teleconsult/* and /api/doctors/next-available not called by any active JSX (see finish thoughts). No action needed.
seed_data_creation: Test creates then cleans up blocked_dates and blocked_sessions for Dr. Vikas Jha on future dates; walk-in test uses today's date and cleans up after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file test_staff_slots_leave_block.py in /app/backend/tests can be reused as a regression suite for doctor-leave slot filtering. It picks a working date automatically (Vikas Jha works Mon-Sat, off Sunday) so is date-agnostic. Doctor name must be 'Dr. Vikas Jha' and clinic 'Pushpa Clinic' when calling /api/diagyn-staff/slots/available or /api/appointments/booked-slots.
rca of the issue: Root cause was that the staff portal's dedicated slots endpoint /api/diagyn-staff/slots/available (in routes/diagyn_staff/slots.py) was written before doctor leave management existed and only excluded already-booked appointment times + hard-coded reserved slots. It never consulted db.doctor_schedules where blocked_dates/blocked_sessions are written by POST /api/doctor-schedule/block-date and block-session. So even after a doctor blocked their leave, the staff Book/Walk-in flows kept showing normal bookable slots. Fix adds a call to the shared get_doctor_schedule_by_name() helper from appointment_routes.py and (i) returns empty slots + 'on leave' message when the date is in blocked_dates, (ii) excludes slot times within any blocked_session start/end range from morning_slots/evening_slots/available_slots for the given date. Verified via 7 pytest scenarios against the live preview backend.
